summary.caption: A wide four-panel visual poem showing one dancer transforming into a celestial flowering tree, consistent figure and camera position across panels, midnight blue background, luminous coral and gold accents, elegant editorial fantasy illustration with clean narrow gutters.

items.label: text
items.caption: Small refined gold title spanning the upper margin.
items.text: BECOMING / A STUDY IN FOUR MOVEMENTS

items.label: character
items.caption: Panel one: a poised contemporary dancer in a simple coral costume, standing upright with arms folded close, full-body profile.

items.label: character
items.caption: Panel two: the same dancer beginning to transform, arms opening as delicate golden branches emerge from the shoulders, full body.

items.label: character
items.caption: Panel three: the same dancer mid-transformation, elongated limbs becoming luminous branches and coral blossoms swirling around the torso.

items.label: object
items.caption: Panel four: a fully transformed elegant celestial tree retaining the dancer's graceful pose, gold branches, coral flowers and roots floating above the floor.
